notes.title: Update 1.3 - Splitscreen Multiplayer
notes.notes:
Exciting news for Targets! We've added a 2-player co-op split-screen mode, just in time for Steam's Couch Co-Op Festival. Grab a friend and two controllers to tackle the action together!

This feature took a bit longer to implement than I initially expected—but as they say, "I didn't do it because it was easy; I did it because I thought it would be easy." 😅

The demo has been updated too with the new co-op mode, so dive in and let us know what you think!"

notes.title: A new level can now be unlocked...
notes.notes:
A new level has arrived to the world of targets. Destroy 130 targets and open a portal into the unknown once again. 

Face a new frontier, adapt to the unfamiliar, and conquer the cosmos in this thrilling update. Will you emerge as the ultimate marksman and unravel the mysteries of the unknown?

Update notes:
*lvl4 can now be unlocked after hitting 130 targets on lvl1. 
*Improved challenge: the player is now a mortal from level1. 
*Graphic options: you can now try 3 graphic settings ingame using the keyboards keys "7" Low, "8" Medium or "9" High(default). Hopefully it will allow more hardware specs to run the game smoothly.

notes.title: A mysterious portal has been opened...
notes.notes:
Embark on a thrilling odyssey as you follow the Targets into a mesmerizing adventure that transcends dimensions. 
Journey through a mystic portal and unlock an extraordinary new power that defies the constraints of time. But beware, for with this new ability comes a poignant reminder of your mortality. Confront the delicate balance between power and the fleeting nature of existence, as you strive to protect not only the world but yourself.
With this first major update to "Targets" your journey changes into a test of strength and an exploration of the true depths of your power and mortality.

notes.title: Targets: the first update!
notes.notes:
"Targets" has now been updated for the first time!

The game will now auto-save your progress every minute and every time you pick a Coin, so you can dive back into the world of "Targets" from where you left off, without losing your hard-earned progress!

The number of coins you need to unlock sprint has been reduced from 30 to 25 so you can look for the last coins and targets all across the map in record time.
There are now some clues in the game about the location of the 35 coins. 

You can now use the "B" key to turn Motion Blur On/Off during gameplay. Some players prefer motion blur off but keeping it On (as default) may help the game look smoother on some hardware. 

There's also other minor small tweaks that hopefully will improve the experience. 

Next planned update: lvl2
